title: The long horizon of animal study preregistration: Attitudes, barriers, and myths
content:
by Pasquale Pellegrini, Ulf Toelch

Nearly half of Swiss animal researchers have never heard of preregistration. A survey published in PLOS Biology maps their attitudes, barriers, and misconceptions, and identifies what it would take to change minds.
